relationships.subject: ACC-VTA-ACC positive-feedback loop
relationships.evidence_quote: Disruption of this feedback loop relieves hyperalgesia and anxiodepressive-like behavior in a mouse model of neuropathic pain, both acutely and in the long term.

relationships.subject: ACC-VTA-ACC positive-feedback loop
relationships.evidence_quote: positive-feedback loop mediates the progression to and maintenance of persistent pain and comorbid anxiodepressive-like behavior

key_findings: ACC glutamatergic neurons projecting to the VTA inhibit VTA dopaminergic neurons indirectly via local VTA GABAergic interneurons, and this effect is reinforced after nerve injury.
The resulting ACC-VTA-ACC positive-feedback loop maintains persistent neuropathic pain and comorbid anxiodepressive-like behavior, and disrupting it is analgesic and anxiolytic.
